title: Incident Sidecar: Compact Alert Origami & Relay Summary (prototype)
creator: Aisha Malik
description: Design a compact, right-hand 'incident sidecar' that surfaces concise alert context (origin, SLO delta, last 3 related traces), lightweight cost estimate, and one-click handoff actions. The sidecar should be unobtrusive in dashboards and rollout pages but offer a single expandable affordance for deeper incident context and postmortem links. This prototype explores an "origami" fold pattern: a collapsed strip -> mid-expanded card -> full modal deep view. Goals: speed up on-call triage, reduce context-switching to other tools, and make postmortem creation and linking frictionless while preserving privacy and audit controls.
acceptance_criteria: Collapsed strip shows: alert title (truncated), SLO delta badge, 1-line reason, and primary action (acknowledge)
Mid-expanded card surfaces: 3 most recent traces (IDs), last deploy tag, cost estimate (1h projected impact), and link to latest postmortem if present
Deep view modal includes: full incident timeline, anchor to rollout/canary page, create-postmortem flow, and runbook quick-links
All actions emit an auditable event (API hook) and surface the trace ID for engineering
Prototype passes a quick usability test with 5 SRE/Platform engineers (task completion rate >= 80%)
Design tokens and spacing conform to console-2025 style guide and accessibility AA contrast
review_notes: PM (R. Alvarez): prefer single primary action to avoid accidental reassigns; suggested 'ack' as primary and 'reassign' under more actions
Eng (M. Patel): backend needs a lightweight 'incident-context' endpoint to assemble SLO delta, last-deploy, and recent traces. Flag: avoid heavy queries on dashboard list view.
Security (J. Osei): redact PII in trace snippets by default; require 'view sensitive' permission to expand full trace links
SRE (internal pilot): liked compact cost estimate; requested ability to toggle token vs. cpu-cost models for Dedicated customers
decisions: Adopt three-stage origami pattern (strip -> card -> modal) to balance info density and surface area
Do not auto-open postmortem drafts; provide prominent 'Create Postmortem' CTA that pre-fills alert metadata
Cost estimate will be an opt-in heuristic in the prototype, calculated from recent token throughput x region cost table
Expose only trace IDs in collapsed states; full trace links require expanded view and permission check
tradeoffs: Rich context vs. dashboard noise: chose progressive disclosure to keep list performance acceptable
Precomputing SLO delta for speed vs. staleness: will show cached delta with 'last-updated' timestamp and refresh on expand
Surface cost heuristics for quick triage but not authoritative billing figures; link to billing dashboard for official numbers
next_steps: Hand off Figma frames and interaction spec to frontend for a 2-week spike (include perf budget targets)
Engineering spike to implement incident-context API with 200ms p95 latency target for collapsed requests
Run 5 participant usability sessions with SREs and product engineers; iterate on wording for actions
Coordinate with Security to define 'view sensitive' permission and audit log events
Prepare a Beta rollout plan gated by telemetry (engagement rate and action success rate)
